name: com.oauth.onesdkbranch.view.login.oneSDKBranchLoginView
description: When the app requests sign-in, the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch shows password login and configured account-provider or guest sign-in options; it also links to account creation and password recovery.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this CIB SDK sign-in screen, so its OneSDK login flow may fail.
